title: Use an anvil to fix and name things

steps.title: Craft an anvil
steps.say: You need 3 [blocks of iron](item:iron_block) on top and 4 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) below. That is 31 iron ingots in all.

steps.title: Fix a tool
steps.say: Put the tool in the first slot and what it is made of in the second, like [diamonds](item:diamond) for a [diamond sword](item:diamond_sword).

steps.title: Join 2 tools
steps.say: Or put 2 of the same tool in. You get one fixed tool, with the enchantments of both.

steps.title: Add an enchanted book
steps.say: Put a tool in the first slot and an [enchanted book](item:enchanted_book) in the second to add its enchantment.

steps.title: Give it a name
steps.say: Type a new name at the top before you take it out. Name a [name tag](item:name_tag) this way, then use it on a pet.

steps.title: It costs XP
steps.say: Each use costs experience levels. If it says too expensive, the cost is over 39 levels.

steps.title: It wears out
steps.say: Every use can crack the anvil a little. After a while it breaks, so keep iron for a new one.
